name: gth-app
description: GTH - SaaS de RRHH y Nómina para Colombia (monorepo)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run ensure:env && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:seed
scripts.deploy:db: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:deploy
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.dev: npm run ensure:env && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
